column1: 5.5.4.5.1 Set Passive Track Time. Set Passive User shall login into SCD application
in ‘Online Mode’ and SCD Main Window shall be displayed to access this GUI. User shall
click on this menu item to view existing passive track time or set new one at ES Processor.
A GUI (as shown in Figure-5.277) with passive track time shall be displayed. Tracks will
be marked by ES Processor as passive if they are not updated for passive time interval.
